title: deer-flow.design_request.error v1
description: Structured failure from Deer Flow's DesignRequestBusConsumer when command parsing or visualization fails. A companion hearth.design.generated.v1 error result is emitted so the original caller still receives a reply.

entity_key.description: Target entity key, or the emitter's 'unknown' fallback when parsing failed before one was available.

message.description: Exception detail, truncated by the emitter.

request_event_id.description: CloudEvents id of the triggering design request, empty when unavailable.
